data.text: Fetched Leo's pushed origin/feat/pydantic-agent-backend @ ee26a9114a4f46171ca16cd00df1c0e777f3a01b. Existing Python app is apps/agent/office (FastAPI+Pydantic AI), startup `cd apps/agent && uv run uvicorn office.api:create_app --factory --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3001`. Native routes are /api/boards, /api/state (tasks/orders/tickets/commands), /api/input, /api/sensor, /api/tasks/:id/decide {approve:bool}; SSE task.updated/state.changed/board.listen. It does not provide /api/stations or /api/requests; /api/device-events returns request:{id} only and button emits board.listen. Twin uses existing full OfficeRequest API; backend integration owner should adapt/reuse Leo's runtime and publish compatible boundary, not create another Python app. Current checkout/unfinished twin work preserved; no merge/push performed.
